image_description: A close-up, shallow depth-of-field photograph of several fresh figs. Some are whole, showing dark purple/brown skin, while others are cut in half or quarters, revealing the characteristic pinkish-red interior flesh and tiny seeds. The lighting is soft, highlighting the texture of the fruit.
